verdict.rationale: Evidence shows an OpenAPI spec is served (openhands-probe-2) and API support is advertised for automation/scripting (openhands-docs-13), implying some API reference exists, but there is no evidence of an interactive documentation UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc 'try it' console) or runnable code examples tied to that spec. missing for 10: interactive API explorer UI, runnable/try-it code examples, confirmation the openapi.json is rendered as browsable docs.
